name: web
description: /web opens a link in terminal-browser in a herdr pane below (the last link of Claude's reply by default); the web_read tool lets Claude read the open page as a bounded capture (title, origin and path, main text, first 50 links), asking once per new site.

split.title: Where /web opens the browser pane
split.description: down: a herdr split below this pane (default); right: a split to the right.
